title: Affine pushforward cohomology normalized on every tilde representative
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\phi:B\to A$, and $f:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ its spectrum map. Assume the sheaf derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] exist, and fix $i\in\mathbb Z$. Write $T_A,T_B$ for associated sheaf and $\Gamma_A,\Gamma_B$ for affine module sections [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. Let $\sigma:\operatorname{res}_\phi T_B\cong T_Af_*$ be the ordinary comparison constructed by applying $T_B$ to the composite $\operatorname{res}_\phi N\to\operatorname{res}_\phi\Gamma_A(T_AN)\cong\Gamma_B(f_*T_AN)$ and then applying the tilde/Gamma counit. For an arbitrary unbounded complex $C$ of $A$-modules, define $q_C:T_B(\operatorname{res}_\phi H^i(C))\to H^i(Rf_*Q(T_AC))$ by the inverse exact-homology comparison for $\operatorname{res}_\phi T_B$, the inverse $Q$/homology comparison, $H^i(Q(\sigma_C))$, and the cohomology of the right-derived unit for $f_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], in this order. These are actual maps, not existential choices. There is a natural isomorphism $d:(L\mapsto T_B\operatorname{res}_\phi\Gamma_AH^i(L))\cong(L\mapsto H^i(Rf_*L))$ on $D_{QCoh}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ [lem-pc-affine-derived-cohomology-presentation]. For every object $L$ of that category, every $C$, and every isomorphism $t:Q(T_AC)\cong L$, let $b_{C,t}:H^i(C)\cong\Gamma_AH^i(L)$ be the tilde unit followed by sections of the inverse exact-tilde homology comparison, the inverse $Q$/homology comparison and $H^i(t)$ [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates]. Then $q_C\circ H^i(Rf_*t)=T_B(\operatorname{res}_\phi b_{C,t})\circ d_L$, where composites are written in diagrammatic order. No boundedness, nonzero-ring or K-flat hypothesis is imposed on $C$.

proof.text: For f affine, higher direct images of every quasi-coherent module vanish. Apply the unbounded acyclic derived pushforward cohomology comparison with bound one on each inverse image of an affine open. Use the comparison induced by the right-derived unit, computed by a K-injective resolution and the truncation argument of 08D4, rather than an arbitrary choice of the existence-only isomorphism. This gives H^i(Rf*L) naturally isomorphic to f*H^i(L).

The affine tilde/Gamma counit and the natural identity-on-sections pushforward/restriction comparison identify f*H^i(L) with T_B res_phi Gamma_A H^i(L). Compose the inverse of the preceding normalized cohomology comparison to obtain d. Exact tilde and exact restriction of scalars give q_C as specified. The tilde adjunction triangle identity identifies its termwise comparison with the same ordinary-to-derived unit. Thus q_C equals T_B res_phi b_(C,id) followed by d at Q(T_A C).

Apply the naturality equation of d to t. The definition of b_(C,t) is b_(C,id) followed by Gamma_A H^i(t). Reassociate and use functoriality to obtain the displayed equation. For a zero ring all objects and maps are zero; no step excludes that case. The bound-one truncation argument applies to all unbounded C.
